events.did: left the lab that night with a small heart monitor strapped to his chest and instructions to return the next morning
events.quote_anchor: VICTOR left the lab that night with a small heart monitor strapped to his chest, and instructions to return the next morning.

events.did: leaned on the people he passed so that they shifted out of his way like pieces on a chess board
events.quote_anchor: Victor leaned on those he passed, and they moved, like pieces on a chess board, exactly where he wanted them.

events.did: ignored Eli's bait and adjusted his own dials until shallow pain broke out across his skin, making Eli Ever disappear
events.quote_anchor: Instead, he adjusted his own dials, until shallow pain broke out like sweat across his skin.

events.did: strolled into the parking lot where four men were breaking into a car and asked them if they had forgotten their keys
events.quote_anchor: “Forget your keys?” he asked, strolling into the lot.

events.did: aimed at the first man, smiled and said “Bang”, and the man buckled clutching his chest yet found no bullet wound
events.quote_anchor: The man buckled with a roar, clutching his chest as if he’d been shot—surely it felt that way—was shocked when he found no bullet wound.

events.did: splayed his fingers and pinned the fourth man against the air, the crowbar crashing to the ground
events.quote_anchor: He splayed his fingers, and the man froze, the crowbar crashing to the ground as Victor forced his hands open, his arms wide.

events.did: was slashed along the ribs by the third thief's knife, the metal grazing his skin
events.quote_anchor: The metal slashed along his ribs, bright but shallow, grazing skin before Victor flung his power out in all directions

events.did: took hold of all four bodies and blew their fuses out, so all four thieves fell unconscious on the concrete
events.quote_anchor: Victor flung his power out in all directions, took hold of all four bodies, and blew their fuses out.

relations.did: Dani gave Victor the drug and a window of eight to twelve hours before he had to come back to the lab
relations.quote_anchor: Eight to twelve hours. That was what Dani had given him.

relations.did: the two had been students together, and Eli walked beside him on the campus that night
relations.quote_anchor: Victor recognized it—it was the same one he’d been wearing their last night as students.

relations.did: Haverty's compound was the thing that had plunged Victor into the void he was not ready to return to
relations.quote_anchor: to plunge back into the void that Haverty’s compound brought, even if it meant a reprieve from pain

relations.did: the four thieves were breaking into a car in a parking lot, and Victor took down all four of them
relations.quote_anchor: he ambled past a parking lot set off the road, and saw four figures crouched around a car, in the process of breaking in, or boosting it.

numbers.did: the window she gave Victor before he had to return: eight to twelve hours
numbers.quote_anchor: Eight to twelve hours. That was what Dani had given him.

numbers.did: the number of men breaking into the car: four
numbers.quote_anchor: saw four figures crouched around a car, in the process of breaking in, or boosting it.

numbers.did: the distance at which the gun went off: ten feet
numbers.quote_anchor: Victor twitched his hand and ten feet away, the gun went off, the shot cracking through the night

numbers.did: the years his restored ability to move and breathe revealed as insufficient gasps: the last three years
numbers.quote_anchor: his ability to move, to think, to breathe again, revealed the last three years for what they were
